column2: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
column4: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.

column2: Audible’s new features let you explore book worlds — and use AI to talk to characters

column2: The new Kindle ditches the raised bezel in a push toward a smaller, lighter e-reader
